transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because lately I just can’t keep my head clear at work. I’ll lose track of what clients are saying, or reread the same chart note over and over, and then I freeze on simple decisions I used to handle without thinking.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I’m not really sure. I know I haven’t felt like myself, but I don’t know if I’d call it depressed exactly.
Have you been worrying a lot lately?
I don’t know. I wouldn’t say I’ve been worrying a lot exactly… it’s more like my mind feels stuck or unclear. I haven’t really noticed myself worrying more than usual.
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time these concentration problems started?

Yeah… around when it started, the clinic lost some staff, and my schedule got shifted into a lot more late-evening coverage. There’s also been heavier crisis paperwork. It’s been about a month since all that changed.
Do these concentration problems get noticeably better when you’re away from work?

Not really. It’s most noticeable at work, though. I’ll lose track while a client is talking, or I’ll keep rereading the same chart note and it just won’t stick. Then I freeze on simple decisions I used to make without thinking.
Over the past month, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I’ve clearly felt hopeless, exactly. I just haven’t felt like myself lately, but I don’t know if I’d call it depressed.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things?
I don’t think so. I mean, I worry about work stuff some, but I wouldn’t say it’s about a lot of different things or that it feels excessive.
Have you been feeling sad most days lately?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad most days. I’ve felt kind of off and low at times, but I’m not sure how to separate that from just being tired or stressed.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. My guitar’s just been sitting in the corner, and I keep bailing on soccer and the shelter. Even stuff I normally like, like cooking or hiking, I’ll try to do it and it just feels like I’m going through the motions. Like there’s no real point to it.
How has your sleep been lately?
Not great. I’ll come home tired, but then I’m just lying there for hours thinking through the day. And when I do finally fall asleep, I wake up before my alarm and it feels like I barely slept.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve been feeling low a lot, but I don’t know if it’s most of the day nearly every day. It kind of comes and goes.
Lately, have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty?

Yeah… I’ve been pretty hard on myself. Like if I miss one small detail in a note or don’t return a call right away, I start telling myself I’m useless, like I’m letting the clients down and everyone at the clinic down too. It feels bigger than it probably should.
In the past month, have you felt down or depressed nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say nearly every day. I’ve definitely felt down a lot this past month, but I haven’t really been tracking whether it’s been almost every day.
In the past month, have you felt depressed?
Yeah, I think I have felt depressed at times this past month. I just don’t know how to put a number on it or say exactly how often.
During the past month, have you felt down or depressed nearly every day?
I honestly don’t know if it’s been nearly every day. I’ve had a lot of low days, but I haven’t been keeping track closely enough to say that for sure.
When you think about how you've been feeling lately, does it seem mainly caused by the changes and stress at work?

Yeah, I think that’s a big part of it. It’s been about a month, since the clinic lost staff and my schedule got pushed into late-evening coverage, plus a lot more crisis paperwork. That’s when I really noticed things shifting.
Over the past month, have you felt down or depressed nearly every day?
I’m not completely sure I’d say nearly every day. It’s been a lot of days, definitely more than usual, but I haven’t been tracking it closely enough to say for sure.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Yeah… I have. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself, but I keep getting thoughts like it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And that scares me, because I know what that can mean.
In the past month, have you felt depressed on most days?
I’m not totally sure. It’s been a lot of days, but I don’t know if I can say most days for sure. I just know I’ve felt pretty low more often than I’m used to.
Lately, have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed myself moving or talking slower than usual. Maybe I’m a bit less energetic, but I don’t know if it shows that way.
